scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a modern building with a tree in the foreground and a busy street in the background. The building has a flat roof supported by four pillars and a large windowed wall on the left side. A person walks past the entrance, while another person stands near the entrance. The street is lined with parked cars and other buildings in the distance. The sun shines down on the scene, casting shadows across the sidewalk and street. The tree in the foreground is leafless and bare, its branches stretching up towards the sky. The ground is paved with gray bricks, and there are two trash cans in front of the building.
